players.product: Faraday rotator plates, optical crystals (incl. TSAG magneto-optical crystals) and precision optics (crystal growth, precision optical processing, coating, device integration)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (2026 half-year results briefing, IR record): in the Faraday rotator business the company keeps raising efficiency while pushing capacity construction and market promotion; Faraday rotator yield keeps improving and the crystal growth cycle has been shortened further. Customer names are a trade secret, and management would not forecast the market share it could win.

Management (IR record): the company's TSAG crystals are used to make high-power laser isolators, not for optical communications. Their ramp depends on process, customer qualification and capacity construction, and production lines will be planned according to customers' certification progress and orders.

Management (IR record): subsidiary Zhiqi Photonics grew fast in the first half, and its full-year development is expected to be in line with expectations. The Phase II Building D project is progressing, with the roof structure completed; supporting facilities and fit-out come next, and the building will be used according to production-line needs once completed.

CASTECH.why: Makes Faraday rotator plates, optical crystals and precision optics used in optical isolators and transceiver components; its Faraday rotator capacity build-out rides optical networking demand.
CASTECH.evidence: CASTECH IR activity record 2026003 (09-02-2026): management is pushing Faraday rotator capacity construction and market promotion, with yield improving and the crystal growth cycle shortened.
